achievements.name: Ode to the Longballo
achievements.description: Hit a homerun.

achievements.name: Gettin' Around
achievements.description: Have your entire lineup make a plate appearance in a single inning against the CPU.

achievements.name: Good Wood
achievements.description: Make contact with a 95+ score power swing at least five times in a single game against the CPU.

achievements.name: Roll It Up
achievements.description: Get two outs on the same play against the CPU.

achievements.name: Gotta Look Good to Play Good
achievements.description: Edit a team logo.

achievements.name: Quadinger
achievements.description: Hit a homerun with the bases loaded.

achievements.name: Travel by Cycle
achievements.description: Hit a single, double, triple, and homerun with the same player in a Season or Elimination game.

achievements.name: We're Back in This
achievements.description: Overcome a 5-run deficit for a win in a Season or Elimination game.

achievements.name: No You Don't
achievements.description: Throw out a CPU-controlled runner while they're attempting to steal a base.

achievements.name: I'll Keep It Fair, Trust Me
achievements.description: While editing a Custom team, increase all of one player's skills to 99.

achievements.name: A Touch of Clutch
achievements.description: Win a game with a walk-off homerun using an "On Fire" or "Jacked" player against the CPU.

achievements.name: Battaire Extraordinaire
achievements.description: Tally a regular season batting average over .400 with a player on your team (60+ plate appearances).

achievements.name: Bracket Boss
achievements.description: Win the championship of a Standard Elimination.

achievements.name: Defensive Meltdown
achievements.description: Witness the opposing team make two errors in a single inning.

achievements.name: Dirty Stuff
achievements.description: Throw a 95+ score power pitch at least five times in a single game against the CPU.

achievements.name: Distinguished Dinger
achievements.description: Hit a 500+ foot homerun.

achievements.name: #Ego99 Challenge
achievements.description: Win a 9+ inning game against the CPU at Ego 99 where both teams are Standard teams.

achievements.name: Flashing the Leather
achievements.description: Make an out with a diving catch.

achievements.name: Fun, Fun, Without a Run
achievements.description: Have a player with 6 RBIs but no runs in a single game against the CPU.

achievements.name: Get a Real Hit Next Time
achievements.description: Get a base hit with a bunt while playing against the CPU.

achievements.name: Golden Sombrero
achievements.description: Strikeout 4 times in a single game with a single player.

achievements.name: Hangin' In There
achievements.description: Foul-off four pitches with a two-strike count against the CPU.

achievements.name: I Just Need One
achievements.description: Pinch hit with a full count and then hit a homerun against the CPU.

achievements.name: Jack Attack
achievements.description: Hit four homeruns in a row against the CPU.

achievements.name: Just Give Up Already
achievements.description: Reach a 10-run lead in a Season or Elimination game.

achievements.name: Keep 'em Guessing
achievements.description: Throw at least one pitch of each pitch type in a single game.

achievements.name: Knight of Knocks
achievements.description: Hit a total of 500 hits.

achievements.name: Lookin' Demoralized
achievements.description: Throw a called 3rd strike for the 3rd out with the bases loaded in a Season or Elimination game.

achievements.name: Pennant Tenant
achievements.description: Make it to the playoffs in a Season of any length.

achievements.name: Perfecto
achievements.description: Pitch a 9+ inning complete-game perfect game in Season or Elimination mode.

achievements.name: Pitchaire Extraordinaire
achievements.description: Tally a regular season ERA under 1.50 with a pitcher on your team (30+ innings pitched).

achievements.name: Put a Ring on It
